draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.10, the 253rd-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 2nd of 2 at FB. He went 220th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (253rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. No rankable athletic testing on record. College production: 33 rushing yards in 2018, 1st of 2 FBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 44 career games and 0 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 0 AV in 2019. Played 6 of 17 games in 2022.
